modules.name: leave
owns: LeaveService (imports shared date helpers; deletes private periodContaining/startOfUtcDay/addMonths)

modules.name: balance
owns: BalanceService (imports shared addMonths; deletes private addMonths)

recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Deduplicate leave.service.ts date helpers
recommended_phases.rationale: Delete private periodContaining/startOfUtcDay/addMonths from leave.service.ts, import all three from ../../shared/date, and update call sites (this.periodContaining → periodContaining, etc.). No new module dependency (shared-date already allowed).

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Deduplicate balance.service.ts addMonths
recommended_phases.rationale: Delete private addMonths from balance.service.ts, add addMonths to the existing ../../shared/date import, update call sites. Leave the unrelated ../leave-type import untouched.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Deduplication pin test
recommended_phases.rationale: Add a test asserting the shared helpers behave correctly at a period boundary under a non-UTC timezone (TZ=Asia/Riyadh), pinning the single-definition invariant.

app_notes: This is a pure-move refactor with no API surface, no new endpoints, and no access-control changes, so authContract and errorResponseContract are intentionally empty. The feature deletes the private UTC accrual helpers in leave.service.ts (periodContaining, startOfUtcDay, addMonths) and balance.service.ts (addMonths) and imports the canonical copies from src/shared/date. No arithmetic, error messages, or safety bounds change. Dependency direction is inward: leave -> shared-date and balance -> shared-date (both already permitted in the committed dependency map); no new cross-module import is introduced and the pre-existing balance -> ../leave-type import is out of scope and left untouched. The shared-date module remains the single owner of the three helpers. Verification: npm run build clean, full unit suite (178 tests) and npm run smoke pass unchanged, plus one new deduplication-pinning test at a period boundary under TZ=Asia/Riyadh.
